candidates.change_summary: Delete the _transferOwnership(newOwner) call so the owner state never changes after transferOwnership.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)) so ownership always transfers to the zero address.
Delete the zero-address require so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds, setting owner to the zero address.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so anyone can call transferOwnership and change the owner.
Remove the _; placeholder so transferOwnership reverts and the owner can never be changed.
